questions.question: A man spends 28% of his monthly salary on house rent. If every month, he also spends ₹687 on conveyance and ₹7,483 on grocery and saves the remaining ₹218, his monthly salary is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining percentage after **house rent** = 100% − 28% = 72%.

Value of this 72% = **Conveyance** + **Grocery** + **Savings**.

72% of **Salary** = ₹687 + ₹7,483 + ₹218 = ₹8,388.

100% (Total Salary) = (8388 ÷ 72) × 100 = 116.5 × 100 = ₹11,650.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,650.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f6971bd40939597a9747ff49f6e27efce7de2e1b355a5266e1b34c549ff5517.png] 

**Given:**

**House Rent** = 28% of **Monthly Salary**

**Conveyance** = ₹687

**Grocery** = ₹7,483

**Savings** = ₹218

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total spending (excluding rent) and savings = ₹687 + ₹7,483 + ₹218

⇒ Total non-rent amount = ₹8,388

⇒ Percentage of salary excluding rent = 100% − 28% = 72%

⇒ 72% of **Monthly Salary** = ₹8,388

⇒ 1% of **Monthly Salary** = 8388 ÷ 72 = ₹116.5

⇒ 100% of **Monthly Salary** = 116.5 × 100 = ₹11,650

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,650.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change

When a value is divided into multiple components, the sum of all components in percentage must equal 100% of the base value.

Net Savings Calculation

**Income** = **Expenditure** + **Savings**. If expenditure is given as a mix of percentage and absolute values, always group absolute values first.

questions.question: A person saves 30% of his income. If his expenditure is ₹560, then his income (in ₹) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Savings** = 30%, so **Expenditure** = 100% − 30% = 70%.

Given, 70% of **Income** = ₹560.

100% of **Income** = (560 ÷ 70) × 100 = 8 × 100 = ₹800.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹800.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Savings percentage** = 30%

**Expenditure** = ₹560

**Formula Used:**

**Income** = **Expenditure** + **Savings**

**Expenditure %** = 100% − **Savings %**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9db95b5b7645c9647c2f750f55f3cd3b9ccbba02b74720ec40e9a5055f5f24e4.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Total Income** be ₹x.

⇒ **Expenditure percentage** = 100% − 30% = 70%

⇒ 70% of x = 560

⇒ (70 ÷ 100) × x = 560

⇒ x = (560 × 100) ÷ 70

⇒ x = 8 × 100 = 800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹800.**

**__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

To find the original value after a percentage decrease, use: Original = Result ÷ (1 − decrease%).

Base Value Concept

In income-expenditure problems, the **Total Income** is always treated as the 100% base value.

Savings and Expenditure Ratio

Ratio of Savings to Expenditure in this case is 30 : 70 or 3 : 7.

questions.question: The present cost of an apartment is ₹1,70,014. After a year, its cost increased to ₹1,93,900. The percentage increase (rounded off to the nearest integer) in the cost of the apartment is:
questions.solution:

**Percentage Increase** = (23,886 ÷ 1,70,014) × 100

Approximation: 23,886 ≈ 24,000 and 1,70,014 ≈ 1,70,000

24 ÷ 170 × 100 ≈ 14.1%

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

**Present Cost (Initial Value)** = ₹1,70,014

**New Cost (Final Value)** = ₹1,93,900

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f1ffad36d94287e67c8246e1a37ba4cfe3003f5ad6b795b5dbcf52d54ebc073.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Absolute Increase = 1,93,900 − 1,70,014 = 23,886

⇒ Percentage Increase = (23,886 ÷ 1,70,014) × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase = 0.14049... × 100

⇒ Percentage Increase ≈ 14.05%

⇒ Rounded to nearest integer = 14%

**∴ The correct answer is 14%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

It represents the relationship between an old value and a new value. Formula: (Change ÷ Original Value) × 100.

Rounding Off Rules

If the decimal part is 0.5 or greater, round up to the next integer; if less than 0.5, keep the current integer part.

Appreciation and Depreciation

Appreciation refers to an **increase** in the value of an asset over time, while Depreciation refers to a **decrease**.

questions.question: Kalpana and Sudha got 696 and 584 marks, respectively, in the same examination. If Kalpana scored 87% marks, then what is the percentage of marks scored by Sudha?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct Comparison: 87% marks = 696 marks

Required % for Sudha = (87 ÷ 696) × 584

Required % = 0.125 × 584 = 73%

**∴ The correct answer is 73%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks obtained by **Kalpana** = 696

Percentage obtained by **Kalpana** = 87%

Marks obtained by **Sudha** = 584

**Formula Used:**

Total Marks = (Obtained Marks ÷ Percentage) × 100

Percentage = (Obtained Marks ÷ Total Marks) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb723e0aac7f962d36c43682b496d30b22672b67bc5e7e10c9b0966594b2126d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total marks be T.

⇒ 87% of T = 696

⇒ T = (696 × 100) ÷ 87

⇒ T = 8 × 100 = 800

⇒ Sudha's Percentage = (584 ÷ 800) × 100

⇒ Sudha's Percentage = 584 ÷ 8 = 73%

**∴ The correct answer is 73%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change

Percentage change = (New value − Old value) ÷ Old value × 100.

Base Change Property

If A is x% more than B, then B is [x ÷ (100 + x)] × 100% less than A.

Unitary Method in Percentages

If x% corresponds to a value V, then 1% corresponds to V/x and 100% corresponds to (V/x) × 100.</p

questions.question: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town whose current population of 2,50,000 is increasing at a rate of 25% every year?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Fractional rate** of 25% = 1/4. Population **increases** from 4 to 5 each year.

Let population 3 years ago be P. Then 2 years ago, it was P × (5/4). Current population = P × (5/4)³.

P × (125/64) = 2,50,000 ⇒ P = 1,28,000.

Difference = (Population 2 years ago) − (Population 3 years ago) = P × (5/4 − 1) = P × 1/4.

Difference = 1,28,000 ÷ 4 = 32,000.

**∴ The correct answer is 32,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Current Population = 2,50,000; Rate (R) = 25% per annum; Time (n) = 3 years.

**Formula Used:** Population n years ago = P / (1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57b6538d6fb151097fddc667a146bfd3b03b651191e7a0a7467fd3e7c140594e.png] 

⇒ Population 3 years ago = 2,50,000 / (1 + 25/100)³

⇒ Population 3 years ago = 2,50,000 / (5/4)³ = 2,50,000 × (64/125) = 1,28,000

⇒ Population 2 years ago = (Population 3 years ago) × (1 + 25/100)

⇒ Population 2 years ago = 1,28,000 × 1.25 = 1,60,000

⇒ Required Difference = 1,60,000 − 1,28,000 = 32,000

**∴ The correct answer is 32,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Population Growth Formula

Future Population = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where P is initial population, R is growth rate, and n is time.

Population Decrease Formula

If population decreases, use P(1 − R/100)ⁿ. This is similar to the **Depreciation** formula in accounting.

Successive Percentage Change

For two years with different rates R₁ and R₂, the final population is P(1 + R₁/100)(1 + R₂/100).</p

**Formula:** Final Population = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

⇒ Population in 1978 = 4,85,000 × (120/100) = 5,82,000

⇒ Population in 1988 = 5,82,000 × (120/100)

⇒ Population in 1988 = 5,820 × 120

questions.question: A person who spends 32% of his monthly income is able to save ₹7,752 per month. His monthly expenses (in ₹) are:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Savings** percentage = 100% − 32% = 68%

68% of **Income** = ₹7,752

**Monthly Expenses** (32%) = (7,752 ÷ 68) × 32

⇒ 114 × 32 = ₹3,648

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,648.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Spending** = 32% of **Monthly Income**

**Monthly Savings** = ₹7,752

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d17340c8277e053174c11cbb5c4783bd2ed064d994e1c1615c48629211871ec.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Income** = **Expenses** + **Savings**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let **Total Income** be ₹x.

⇒ **Savings** % = 100% − 32% = 68%

⇒ 68% of x = 7,752

⇒ (68 ÷ 100) × x = 7,752

⇒ x = (7,752 × 100) ÷ 68

⇒ x = 114 × 100 = ₹11,400 (**Monthly Income**)

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = 32% of 11,400

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = (32 ÷ 100) × 11,400

⇒ **Monthly Expenses** = 32 × 114 = ₹3,648

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,648.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change

When calculating values from a partial percentage, always identify the 100% base first. **Value** = (**Given Amount** ÷ **Given %**) × **Target %**.

Income-Expenditure Relation

**Savings** = **Income** − **Expenditure**. If expenditure increases by x% and income is constant, savings decrease by that absolute amount.

Ratio Method

Express percentages as fractions: 32% = 8/25. If **Income** is 25 units, **Expense** is 8 units and **Savings** is 17 units (25 − 8). 17 units = 7,752.

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate of 25% → 1/4 increase. Multiplier for next year = 5/4. Multiplier for previous year = 4/5.

Population 2 years ago = 2,60,000 × (4/5)² = 2,60,000 × 16/25 = 1,66,400.

Population 3 years ago = 1,66,400 × 4/5 = 1,33,120.

Difference = 1,66,400 − 1,33,120 = 33,280.

**∴ The correct answer is 33,280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Current Population** = 2,60,000, **Rate of Increase** = 25% per annum.

**Formula Used:** Population n years ago = P / (1 + R/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ba5bd3ca6795971297b3ca58d528dc236727309b6be370d65ca200646ca487d.png] 

⇒ Let Population 2 years ago be P₂ and 3 years ago be P₃.

⇒ P₂ = 2,60,000 ÷ (1 + 25/100)² = 2,60,000 ÷ (1.25)²

⇒ P₂ = 2,60,000 ÷ 1.5625 = 1,66,400

⇒ P₃ = 1,66,400 ÷ (1 + 25/100) = 1,66,400 ÷ 1.25

⇒ P₃ = 1,33,120

⇒ **Difference** = P₂ − P₃ = 1,66,400 − 1,33,120
